Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IBIO-01 Bioingegneria

The new researcher will be responsible for conducting scientific research in the field of biomechanics, with a particular focus on the design and evaluation of innovative endoprostheses (for the cardiovascular and orthopedic-spinal systems). Specifically, the candidate will develop digital twins of implantable devices and associated clinical procedures, with a focus on modeling materials and biomechanical interactions with the patient's biological tissues, as well as on the accurate experimental validation of the developed computational models.
